_comment: Route policy read by the kit's hooks/route.ps1 on every prompt and hooks/subagent.ps1 at every subagent start (DES-13). Tunables only. groups: law group id -> words that activate it (whole-word, case-insensitive, matched against the prompt); the group ids must exist as '## GROUP - Title' sections in LAW.md, so an overlay group an adopter adds gets a line here. folders: top-level folder under root -> groups active whenever the session works there. alwaysForSubagents: groups every subagent receives even when nothing routed yet. maxChars: cap per injection, under the host's 10,000-character limit. A route sticks for the session; entry.ps1 clears it on compaction.
